# Giveaways triggers

## Giveaway cancelled

Runs when a giveaway is cancelled and the points for tickets are given back.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%title%` | The prize |
| `%refunded%` | How many points were given back in all |
| `%entrants%` | How many viewers had joined |

<small>Type id: `cuebot.giveawayCanceled`</small>

## Giveaway closed

Runs when a giveaway stops taking entries, by hand or when the time is up. Good for saying "no more entries" before the draw.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%title%` | The prize |
| `%entrants%` | How many viewers joined |
| `%tickets%` | How many tickets there are in all |

<small>Type id: `cuebot.giveawayClosed`</small>

## Giveaway entered

Runs each time a viewer joins a giveaway. Good for a quick "you're in!" reply.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | The viewer who joined |
| `%tickets%` | How many tickets they hold now |
| `%added%` | How many tickets they just got |
| `%title%` | The prize |
| `%platform%` | The site the viewer is on, like twitch |

<small>Type id: `cuebot.giveawayEntered`</small>

## Giveaway opened

Runs when a giveaway opens for entries. Good for announcing the prize and how to join.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%title%` | The prize |
| `%command%` | The chat command to join, like !join |
| `%ticketCost%` | How many points one ticket costs (0 = free) |
| `%maxTickets%` | The most tickets one viewer may get |
| `%duration%` | How many seconds entries are taken (0 = until you close it) |

<small>Type id: `cuebot.giveawayOpened`</small>

## Giveaway winner drawn

Runs once for each winner drawn in a giveaway. Good for a big congratulations alert.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%winner%` | The winner's name |
| `%winnerPlatform%` | The site the winner is on, like twitch |
| `%winnerTickets%` | How many tickets the winner had |
| `%title%` | The prize |
| `%entrants%` | How many viewers joined |

<small>Type id: `cuebot.giveawayWinner`</small>
